## Outreach - Telegram Commands
Tap the commands printed in the job digest:
- `/p<jobid>` priority (eligible again on the next run)
- `/x<jobid>` remove priority
- `/a<jobid>` mark applied

Only messages from Outreach Config.telegramChatId are obeyed. Activating this workflow registers the bot webhook (needs the public HTTPS domain).
